barbell-row.criteria: Overhand shoulder-width grip, fixed hip hinge, bar travels toward abdomen and lowers under control; no floor reset.

hip-thrust.criteria: Upper back on stable bench, padded bar at hip crease, feet planted, extend hips to trunk/thigh alignment without hyperextension. One second top pause. Entry and exit omitted.

biceps-curl.criteria: Simultaneous supinated dumbbell curl. Upper arms remain at sides, controlled elbow flexion and extension without trunk swing.

limits: Procedural educational demonstration, not captured human motion or biomechanical certification.
